description.value: The Geoffrey R. Weller Library is the main academic library of the University of Northern British Columbia, located on the Prince George campus. It serves both the university community and external community members who can become registered patrons. Touring cyclists passing through Prince George may find it a quiet destination for research, study space, or print services.

address.value: 3333 University Way, Prince George, BC V2N 4Z9

The address and general campus phone are drawn from the website footer since OSM carries no contact data.
